promotion_rule: Only pass to separate selector if holdout paired candidate-minus-single_B 95% CI lower bound >0, candidate and all controls fill identical preregistered budgets, canary and independence pass, lane literal gates pass, decoded uniqueness and not-union pass, and format/reasoning checks pass. No weekly slot is selected or used by this runner.
verdict_rule: Run card is negative unless every preregistered gate passes; a passing result is selector-eligible only, not competition-slot approval.
